name: Astrid Bergström
bio:
Astrid's meticulous nature led her to quality control after graduating from KTH Royal Institute of Technology with a degree in mechanical engineering. Growing up near a rallycross track, she developed a keen ear for identifying inconsistencies in engine performance, a skill that translated well to spotting potential issues in race car components. While many engineers chase innovation, Astrid finds satisfaction in ensuring reliability and consistency, believing that winning races starts with flawless execution.

Her approach to quality control is deeply methodical. Astrid relies heavily on data analysis and rigorous testing protocols. She's not afraid to challenge assumptions or question procedures if she believes there's room for improvement in the quality assurance process. While still early in her career, Astrid's attention to detail and dedication to preventing errors make her a valuable asset to any motorsport team.

Astrid's pragmatic approach means she favors data-driven solutions over gut feelings, and she is always looking for ways to improve efficiency and accuracy in her work. She understands the importance of teamwork and communication, ensuring that everyone is on the same page when it comes to quality standards.

physical.hairStyle: Long, straight hair, usually pulled back in a neat ponytail
physical.description: Astrid is of average height with a slender build and often wears practical, non-nonsense clothing.

quirks: Always carries a small notebook and pen to jot down observations.
Has a habit of tapping her pen against her teeth when concentrating.
Insists on calibrating all measurement tools at the start of each shift.
